form_title: Financial Campaign Report for County and Local School Board Candidates

reports.notes: Born-digital fillable form (footer v. 4.20); figures typed. Punctuation is inconsistent on the page and is preserved verbatim: B, C and F carry a thousands comma and two decimals ('10,778.00'), while D, E and the close box do not ('8705.50', '2072.50'); Box A is a bare typed '0' (a written zero, not a blank cell). Street address, city and signature are redacted upstream by the county (black bars), so residence_city is ''. Office prints as 'Utah County Sheriff' and agrees with index.csv. Date box, 'Date of Report' and the summary page all read 04/01/2022. TWO SUMMARY PAGES WERE FLAGGED (5 and 7) but page 7 is the county's internal CAMPAIGN FINANCIAL DISCLOSURE CHECKLIST (staff-reviewed 4/4/22 twice), not a second report - this 8-page PDF holds ONE report.
